Device Name
StrataMR™ Valves and Shunts (Guider Tool)
Indications for Use (Describe)
Medtronic StrataMR™ Valves and Shunts are designed to provide continuous cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) flow from the
ventricles of the brain into the right atrium of the heart or the peritoneal cavity. The design enables the physician to
noninvasively adjust valve pressure/performance level pre- and post-implantation by using magnetic adjustment tools
without the need for radiographic confirmation.
